name: The Nettestadt Troll
source:
You play the role of a young woman, Katja, in the quaint hamlet of Nettestadt, in medieval Bavaria. After a failed uprising, there is a new fear: The Nettestadt Troll. To appease this lost soul and leave the town alone, you are sent to live in an isolated cottage outside of town as the troll's concubine.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221105033641/http://www.renai.us/game/nettestadt.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演一名叫Katja的年轻女子，生活在中世纪巴伐利亚古朴的Nettestadt小村。一场起义失败后，新的恐惧降临了：Nettestadt巨魔。为了安抚这个迷失的灵魂，让它不再侵扰小镇，你被送往镇外一座孤立的小屋，成为巨魔的侍妾。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221105033641/http://www.renai.us/game/nettestadt.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
